paper_metadata.title: Exploring the alloying effects on generalized stacking fault energy and ideal strength of Ni and Ni3Al phases in Ni-based superalloys

evidence.quote: To clarify the different effects of alloying elements on the strength of Ni and Ni3Al, this study employs First-principles methods to investigate the effects of refractory elements Re, Ru, Ta, Mo and W on the generalized stacking fault energy and ideal strength of Ni and Ni3Al, respectively.
